goalResults.dailyCalories: Eat per day to reach your goal
goalResults.belowBmrWarning: Required intake is below your BMR ({bmr} kcal) — this pace is likely unsafe. Consider more days.
goalResults.statusOk: Sustainable pace — easy to keep up.
goalResults.statusMaintain: Target equals your current weight — eat at maintenance.
goalResults.statusTooFastLoss: Faster than 1% of body weight per week — consider giving yourself more time.
goalResults.statusTooFastGain: Gaining faster than 0.5% of body weight per week adds mostly fat.
goalResults.statusMissingGoal: Enter a target weight and a date in the future.
